description: Common structure every ENC-1a encoder-settings fixture validates against. `kind` names the round-trip / absent-key / redaction / flag-off / contract branch exercised; `setup` carries the endpoint URL + api key + flag_on override for the route harness; `expected_outcome` is ok or error; `expected_result` pins the fields the writer+reader round-trip and the redaction scan must assert (written_url, written_key, apiKeySet, key_never_in_get, get_omits_fields, post_disabled, byte_identical, contract_additive).
title: ENC-1a encoder-settings fixture envelope
